company.title: Company settings
company.description: Manage your company's logo and branding. Available to admins.

logo.title: Logo
logo.body: Square image, JPG or PNG. Shown in the app header and on invoices later.

imageAttachments.body: Allow employees to upload images (JPG/PNG) as task attachments and submissions. When disabled, only documents are accepted on tasks.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Edit your personal information. Organizational details are managed by your admin.

sections.organizationalHint: These fields are set by your admin. Ask HR or your manager if anything looks wrong.

files.sectionBody: Upload your profile photo and supporting documents. Replacing a file keeps the previous version on record.
files.replaceHint: Current version: v{version}. Uploading again will replace it.

idCard.title: ID card
idCard.body: Photo of your government-issued ID (JPG or PNG). Visible only to you and HR.

certificate.title: Certificates
certificate.body: Diplomas, training certificates, anything supporting your role. Add as many as needed.

profile.sensitiveNotice: Sensitive fields are audit-logged. Your access is recorded.

toast.noPermission: You don't have permission to see this user's sensitive details.

roles.heading: Roles
roles.description: Direct role grants. The user's effective permissions are the union of all granted roles plus any system-role assignments.

approvals.title: Pending approvals
approvals.description: Invitations waiting for your approval. Each invite walks through an approval chain set in company settings.

rejectDialog.title: Reject invitation
rejectDialog.description: {name} will not be invited. The invitation is archived; a new invite for the same email can be sent later.

toast.approvedFinal: Approved. Invitation email is on its way.

welcome.title: Welcome — let's finish your profile
welcome.description: A few details so your team can reach you. Everything here is optional; you can skip and come back to it from your profile page later.

step1.title: Your date of birth
step1.description: Used for birthday reminders and HR records. Visible only to you and HR.

step2.title: Emergency contact
step2.description: Who should we contact in an emergency? Optional but recommended.

step3.title: Where do you live?
step3.description: A short address is enough — city + neighbourhood works. Optional.

toast.skipped: No problem — you can add this from your profile later.

people.title: People
people.description: Browse your company's users. Managers see their department; HR and admins see the whole company.

teams.description: Teams within this department. Supervisors can be assigned once user management lands.

departments.description: Manage your departments as a tree. Add sub-departments by hovering a node and clicking +.

roles.description: Manage what each role can do. Built-in role names are fixed; their permission lists are editable.

roles.unknownKeysHelp: These keys are on the role but not in the current catalog. They're preserved on save.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Manage your company's branches. Archive hides a branch from default lists.
branches.createDescription: Branches are physical locations within your company.
branches.editDescription: Update branch details. Archive from the list.
branches.empty: No branches yet. Create the first one.
